adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no `TopicEmbed` exists it always enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The loading template unconditionally reloads the page every 30 seconds (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb), so if the embed can never be created (e.g., `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` returns early because `embed_by_username` user is blank, `TopicEmbed.import_remote` raises on `open(url)`, or other permanent retrieval failures), the iframe will stay in an infinite “Loading Discussion...” loop with no terminal/error state and will keep re-enqueuing retrieve jobs on every reload.
